newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Hayleys up 4.10 pct on growth prospects.
newsitem.headline: Hayleys up 4.10 pct on growth prospects.

text.p: Shares of Sri Lanka blue chip Hayleys Ltd rose 4.10 percent, or 8.75 rupees, to 222 in early Friday trade, brokers said.
"Hayleys is the holding company of a diversified group which is exposed to plantations and manufacturing which are sectors that are expected to do well in 1997," said a broker.

Improved money supply after the Central Bank cut reserve ratios and easing interest rates are expected to benefit the manufacturing sector. Plantations are seen doing well mainly due to continuing demand for Sri Lanka tea.
